in_latin.name: Noach
in_latin.meaning: meaning of name is a shortened form of Noach, son of Lamech.
in_latin.long_meaning: Noach, in Latin, is derived from the Hebrew name Noach, meaning 'rest, comfort' or 'refreshment', referring to the calmness after a storm. It is associated with the biblical figure Noach, son of Lamech, who built an ark to save himself, his family, and two of every kind of animal from the great flood. The name Noach symbolizes hope, renewal, and the covenant between God and humanity.
